Unique Scanner Feature (FREE!) – Find and remove images not used anywhere on your site. No other free plugin has this!

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Go to Plugins > Add New
  2. Search for “WBN Image Optimizer”
  3. Click Install Now
  4. Click Activate
  5. Go to Image Optimizer in your admin menu

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  3. Choose the downloaded file
  4. Click Install Now
  5. Click Activate

After Activation

  1. Go to Image Optimizer in admin menu
  2. Click “Select Images” to choose from Media Library
  3. Choose a preset or customize settings
  4. Click “Optimize Selected Images”
  5. Try the Scanner tab to find unused images!
sections.faq:
Is this really free?

Yes! 100 lifetime free optimizations + Unused Image Scanner. The Pro version adds higher quotas and multi-site licensing.

What makes this different from other image optimizers?

We’re the ONLY free image optimizer with an Unused Image Scanner. Plus 100 lifetime optimizations (not monthly limits).

Are my original images safe?

Absolutely! Every image is automatically backed up before optimization. You can restore originals anytime with one click.

What’s the difference between WebP and AVIF?

  • WebP – Widely supported, 60-70% smaller files
  • AVIF – Newer format, up to 80% smaller, but less browser support

Both are safe to use – WordPress provides automatic fallbacks for older browsers.

How does the Unused Image Scanner work?

It scans your entire Media Library and checks if each image is used in:
* Featured images
* WooCommerce product galleries
* Gallery shortcodes
* Post/page content
* Site icons and logos

If not found anywhere, it’s marked as unused.

Can I optimize existing images?

Yes! Use “Select Images” to choose any images from your Media Library and optimize them.

Will this work with my theme?

Yes! WBN Image Optimizer works with any WordPress theme. It optimizes images in your Media Library.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The “Products” preset is specifically designed for WooCommerce product images.

What happens when I reach 100 optimizations?

You’ve used your lifetime quota. You can:
1. Manually optimize images with other tools
2. Upgrade to Pro for 120/month
3. Still use the Scanner feature (always free!)

Can I restore optimized images?

Yes! Every original is automatically backed up. Go to any image in Media Library and click “Restore Original”.

Will this slow down my site?

No! Optimization happens in your WordPress admin, not on the frontend. Your site will actually be FASTER with smaller images.

What PHP version do I need?

PHP 7.4 or higher. We recommend PHP 8.0+ for best performance.

Does it work with Multisite?

Yes! Each site in your network gets its own 100 lifetime optimizations.

How do I upgrade to Pro?

Visit webnest.co.il/product/wbn-image-optimizer-pro/ to purchase a Pro license.
